name: Meguri
source: The maid of the Ryuugasaki family. She reassures [url=https://vndb.org/c147197]Sasari[/url], who has been chosen to marry into the family. She tells her to be more confident in having been chosen, and helps her to fit into the Ryuugasaki family by telling her how to successfully perform her role.
